dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Welcome. Here to meet with Lady Ningguang, I presume?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello there.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Yes, nice to meet you as well. We were expecting you, in fact. Your movements correspond to the intelligence we have on hand.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: If you are looking for Lady Ningguang... Well, this is the Jade Chamber, the foremost intelligence hub and the epicenter of all important decisions in Liyue, after all. You've come to the right place.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Although, based on the intel on file, we estimated that you would arrive a whole two hours earlier than you actually did...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I must reflect on the cause of this discrepancy. Was our source at fault, or did we make an error in our calculations?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just passing through, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Is that so? How fascinating...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I find it hard to believe that you came here for leisure alone. After all, this is the very same Jade Chamber that you helped to rebuild.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: All intel heretofore gathered indicates that no one comes to the Jade Chamber without good reason. This rule has yet to see exception.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: As Lady Ningguang's secretary and one in charge of collecting and organizing intelligence, I must strive to get a handle on the information of all guests, even ones as esteemed as yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Goodbye, and may fortune find you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I really respect Lady Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Many people do, including myself.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: The Tianquan's words can move mountains, and everyone knows it. My task is to help oversee Lady Ningguang's intelligence network.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang's razor-sharp mind tears through vast amounts of information at pace, and quickly reaches a verdict. These pearls of wisdom are then discarded from the Jade Chamber, giving guidance on "prosperity" to the world below...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Do you, too, wish to learn of such things?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Welcome, are you here to meet with Lady Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That I am.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: As we expected, your aims correspond to the intelligence we have on hand.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: If you are looking for Lady Ningguang, you have come to the right place. This the Jade Chamber, the foremost intelligence hub and the epicenter of all important decisions in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Although, based on the intel on file, we estimated that you would arrive a whole two hours earlier than you actually did...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I must reflect on the cause of this discrepancy. Was our source at fault, or did we make an error in our calculations?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Is that so? How fascinating...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I find it hard to believe that you came here for leisure alone.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Our intel indicates that no one comes to the Jade Chamber without good reason. This rule has yet to see exception.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: But make no mistake, we will ascertain your motivations whether or not you are forthcoming with them, and they will enter our records in due course. Do not underestimate our intelligence network.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Goodbye, and may fortune find you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Ah. Where are my manners? You may call me Baiwen.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: I am Lady Ningguang's secretary, and I am in charge of data collection and organization.
